company_info.company_description: "Our mission is to make the switch to solar energy easy and rewarding for every household. We specialise in installing solar systems statewide, working closely with clients to provide tailored solutions for their homes.When you contact us, you are dealing with locals who genuinely care about you and the long-term success of your solar system."
company_info.specializations: installing solar systems statewide, working closely with clients to provide tailored solutions for their homes

reviews.review_description: Quote was reasonable they turned up when they said they would and had it installed the same day by 3.30.would recommend this company

Clear communication from sales rep. Installation complete soon after acceptance of offer. Checked by sales rep. Advised re follow up and how to make most benefit of system.I spoke to another company but they were pushing me to take loan. Another company rep came to site and was pushing battery installation which I didn't want. Also was very expensive for same inverter and unknown panels.

Very competitive quote - they were happy to meet my requirements. Installation was efficient and professional. They appeared to know what they were doing and were happy to explain the process. Couldn’t fault the process. Follow up and paperwork was prompt and efficient also. I was around when it was finalised but a phone call to the office was sufficient to complete the set up. Very pleased with whole process.
The company had the best systen at the best price for what I wanted.
A good process from start to end. Good sales person, helpful advice, good installation and a good price.
Great communication throughout the process and from start to finish it couldn't be easier.
This company terrific in every way from start to finish would strongly recommend them!

Justin came to our home for the quote.  He is knowledgeable and friendly, and gave us some important factors to think about that we had not been aware of.  Moreeta takes a very personal approach with her customers which gave us re-assurance and confidence at all times.  The installation was very efficient and tidy .. we changed the lay-out slightly on the day which was not a problem, and the overall look of the panels is really good.  Matt was very helpful and friendly throughout the process.  All aspects of the rest of the process were completely looked after when the system was installed .. the technical inspection has been arranged, the tariff change and grid connection has been sent through to our supplier.  Very happy with the purchase.

Tasmanian Energy Company made it all so very easy for me to go solar.Clear proposal.  Friendly and answered all questions clearly.  Very prompt installation and all the installers too were very helpful and so quick.  But thorough.They organised everything for me.I am so grateful.  I see lots of credits going into my aurora account.  So glad I went ahead and chose this company.Suzan
Quick response to my enquiry.  Salesperson came to my place and explained what was required in terms that I could understand. Quick instalment.

I obtained 3 quotes all were within $100.00 of each other. All salespeople were friendly and courteous, though knowledge on the size of system and the location on the install of the panels did vary. The quote paperwork assessment was professionally generated. I decided to go with TEC due to the promise by the saleswoman that the company would provide a high level of communication throughout the install process and specifically post install with grid connection and understanding the operation  of the solar system with use of the Sungrow App. The electricians that did the install were on time and took pride in their work and left the site tidy . I was informed by the electrician that I would receive a notification email for registration of my account with Sungrow within an hour or two so I could connect the App to the system in order to follow the operating metrics. It has now been over 3 working days since the system has been installed and I am yet to receive the notification email. Over this period I have contacted TEC representatives on 3 occasions , by email, phone and text . I have only received one form correspondence over this time (an email ) asking if I had received the account registration email from Sungrow. I  immediately replied by email I had not. I am still unsure if the system is formally connected to the grid or when the system is to be inspected by TasNetworks. Being a novice to Solar electricity generation I was expecting (and was promised) informative and educational post install customer service . In fact with my enquiries to TEC  post quotation acceptance and install, response times have been poor and I have had to follow up on each occasion. I hope the system has no faults as I am concerned how TEC would respond given this example of current customer service.
Quick to quote and not pushy. Explained everything in simple terms. Fast turnaround to installation.
Friendly and informative quote and sales team.Punctual, efficient installation.

They worked with us to get the panels and inverters we wanted and were quick to install. There was just a bit of mucking around after the installation just to get the app set up and showing us the generation. Overall, we are very happy.

Quote process included several phone calls and emails. Towards the final decision, phone conversations resulted in both parties converging to best position.They started the ball rolling with orders and communication to grid authority very soon after final price agreement
From your old supplier TECExcellent customer service and very well arranged

The quoting process was excellent. I felt that Justin really understood my needs and helped me navigate the complexity of solar power.  A few years back I had got some quotes and been so completely overwhelmed by all the options and variables that I did nothing!The installation went very smoothly and the team were most helpful in showing me how to connect to the App and turn the system on once my Smartmeter had been installed.  There was a minor hiccup when I discovered that my ceiling insulation had not been fully re-instated but they returned immediately, were very apologetic and re-positioned the pink batts correctly.The Smartmeter was installed 16 days later and I was then able to switch the system on and it worked beautifully until someone switched off the PV Array DC Isolator 9 days afterwards.  I'm not sure who did that, it was the day of the inspection, maybe the inspector?!  I sent a screenshot of the App to Tasmanian Energy Company and they talked me through turning it back on over the phone.  The after hours support I have had from TEC has been fantastic!
great installers, helpful and informative, kept to the advised timelines

The whole process took 4 months. I began by using Solar Quotes assistance in December 2022 and the installation was finished in late March 2023. All three quotes that I was sent would have been satisfactory. The hard part was choosing between them. All were nice informed people. I read the dscussions from SQ and decided to go Trina panels and Fronius inverter. That eased my choice.The installation was done in 3.5 hours. All very good experienced workers. The electrician from Tas. Energy also sorted out an old decayed cable problem and replaced the switchboard with a modern unit. Farewell to fuse wire safety controls as a result.Customer service was pleasant and the slowness of the approval process is of course largely due to the government bureaucracy. There were many weeks between inspections and approval. I am still waiting for the new required meter from Aurora energy.

Great to deal with.  Friendly and helpful.  Went through a range of options and helped us select what was right for our situation and budget. Experienced and thorough installer.  Installation was ahead of schedule and the company were very good at dealing with energy supply company as well.  Would throughly reccommend.
Friendly service, listened to what l wanted as it wasn't the usual installation setup and installed very quickly by professional tradesmen.

Sales and quotes were great they came to our door and the agent was really friendlyThen communications went quiet lack lustre, we’d converse over the phone and then a different quote or option was emailed at least 3 times. Lots of rework happened which happened via phone call and then the wrong quote was sent again.A friend advised that I was being overcharged as they work in Solar (commercial) and I emailed and the price was reduced $1360 by asking this which was surprising and a bit disappointing.The installation electricians left mess all through our backyard (a protective sheeting that might have covered panels I’m not sure).Then our hot water wasn’t hot on the Friday evening of the install, I figured it was Tariff 93 and the metre timer. This was incorrect and the hot water cylinder power was wired incorrectly (the hot water power breaker was incorrectly wired into the RCD breaker causing the breaker to trip every time the hot water was turned on) which meant a phone call to an electrician over the weekend that we had to organise.The people we dealt with were lovely but it took a lot of time and rework that unfortunately we didn’t have.Another person I know went through the same company around the same time and had zero issues so it could have been bad luck for us.

The sales/quoting process and installation were excellent! I  just experienced that the after sale service is extremely disappointing. I requested a service call for my two year old Converter five days ago and I am still waiting for someone to attend.Five days no credits.
All good.  Installed according to plan and I have nothing but praise.  Very Professional.

Spoke on phone and then had personal visit. We felt Moreeta was completely genuine and made us comfortable and we didn’t feel pushed. Nick arrived on time, explained the process and how they needed to go about it. They completed the job promptly with minimal inconvenience and left no mess behind. Grid connection was not a problem as we already had a smart meter installed from our power provider. We chose not to go on tariff 93.Our system has since been inspected for quality. Inspector really impressed.Our son was impressed and has now had a system installed also as has a friend after our recommendation.

Excellent company, very pleasant to deal with, kept me well informed on each of the steps for installation, system is functioning beautifully, excellent app to view all the details and solar panel history, highly recommend.

Out of the three companies I received quotes from, the one from the Tasmanian Energy Company was the most reasonable and Moreeta was the only manager who came to my home. She was friendly, knowledgeable and immediately inspired trust. We had several discussions as I wanted an 8 kw system and she found the right solution to achieve that. The system works very well. In good sunny days has already produced over 50 kw and I’m sure it will pay for itself in 3-4 years.The installer, Nick, did it all by himself; he had to come back the next day as work was interrupted by rain. He explained clearly how the inverter works and helped me install the app on my phone.Thank you, Moreeta and Nick! You are a great team. I was very happy to work with you and I would recommend you wholeheartedly.
TEC where very good to deal with and I would recommend them as a professional solar installer.

Had some hiccups getting the installer on site. Initially I took time off work to meet with them only to find out 2 hours after they were due that they would be a further 2 hours. Office support was very apologetic and lovely but still was an inconvenience! Dropped equipment off that afternoon and installed next day. Installers were efficient and tidy. 7.8 kW system so far has produced 5.8 kW at best in full sun. Would like to have seen more effort in looking at and advising about shading over the year. Not convinced that I have the optimum arrangement in terms of location of the panels.
Everything done very professionally; quotation, communication and installation. Great job. Thanks

The quoting process was professional and turn around was excellent. Good customer service and attentive follow up. There was consistent contact on a timely basis. The install process was slightly longer than expected but there were good reasons for this that were clearly explained. The install team were good communicators and professional.Overall, the job was done well and exceeded expectations.

We have just started reaping the rewards for our new Solar System wow the savings in the first week with little sunshine!!!!  Over half our normal charges!!!Moretta and the team were so helpful, the installers were efficient and so easy to get along with, we had a meter box upgrade as well. The electrician explained the whole system and set up in layman’s terms that we could so easily understand.Lots of research was done before we selected Tas Energy, I would wholeheartedly recommend the team, anyone considering getting solar power would not find a better system or group of professionals in Tasmania.Well done, oh and thank you for getting us such huge savings on our power bill.Stephen
Very happy so far. Best daily generation so far is 47kWh.

The sales and quoting was great they suggested 18 panels 7.47 KW System instead of a 16 panels 6.64KW System and made sure they got the most panels on the north side and when the installers where there they went through the best options.The installers were very polite did a good job explained how it worked an answered  my questions .they came on the day and I received a call to say they were on there way, they tidied up after they finished.Moreeta was very good on customer service has answers all my calls and got back very quickly and helped get the grid connection .
The quotation was clear and precise.The installation was completed very quickly.The installer was informative and polite.

TEC served us very well at particularly busy time of year, and a spike in demand from recent Energy Saver loans. Installation was delayed slightly due to inclement spring weather, and Nick found solutions to panel placement on our difficult roofline on the day. Connection to our recently installed an Aurora smart meter was very prompt so the system was operational (and exceeding expectations) from day one, but still need some support with iSolar monitoring App.TEC maybe need a little more admin/tech support to keep up with demand, but Moreeta was always very friendly and helpful. I would certainly recommend them.

We were really pleased with Tasmanian energy Company. Mooreta was always very helpful, the installers were great an most importantly the system works brillantly. We now have the solar panels, battery and heat pump water heater that means our bills will be negligible, and most importantly we are making a positive contribution to stop climate change.Dr Peter.
Was impressed with product and installation. Had to make a few phone calls to drive process.

TAC responded promptly to Solarquotes process.  Company rep Moreeta gave good advice on approach given constraints. Communication about progress and timetabling after we placed order could have been more proactive on the company's part. Installation by Nick was punctual and he was focussed, communicative and professional.  His work was commended by Government's safety inspectors.System has chugged along since installation and would be happy to recommend company any time

Moreeta was the only came to my house and did an inspection and a face to face consultation. The price was good valued and in an affordable range. The installation was very neatly done. There was a couple small things which didn’t go as planned however it did not bother me at all. Highly recommended!

Very rapid instal by efficient and tidy crew.Was ticked off by the independent electrical standards body soon after.The system is a good quality Chinese panel and inverter. Noted the same size systems have increased in price by nearly $2000 in 12 mths. All being equal it will still pay itself off in savings,albeit a little longer.Good to feel a little control over rising energy market!

Easy to understand and no fuss. The installation was delayed only by Tasmanian spring weather and was complete in less than a day once the weather permitted.Absolutely no regrets and I very much appreciated the help of Fin Peacock as we had no idea where to start.
Great installation but Moreeta is lovely but seems a bit disorganised. Told me wrong day for installation and didn't send updated quote in wiring after change of panels.
Good all round service. Prompt quoting from sales. Very good installer.
Was happy with the quote and prompt service.Installation went smoothly.Great customer service.

We chose this supplier for the fact they could supply Fronius inverters and QCell panels. The installer worked hard for a full day and he was very considerate about where he put the inverter to make sure it stays cool. There were a few hiccups setting up the Fronius app but Moreeta gave us links to great videos to help us.We didn't pick the cheapest install, going for what other Solarquote users have suggested about aiming for a quality install foremost.Moreeta is helpful and helped calm our nerves about getting solar for the first time.I think Expert Electrical would have been our next pick for an installer but they couldn't provide Fronius inverters.

Professional, friendly, easily contactable, very obliging, couldn’t fault Moreeta and the team.After our 3rd bill, we now have a credit on our account, we are getting paid for the feed in.Couldn’t be happier.
Similar from most companies. Could not fault installation.Everything organized for us. We just had to be available for installation etc.All connected today. Very happy.

Well priced system with a good sales process by a friendly and professional company.They helped with all aspects of install including organizing grid connection and meter upgrade. There was a mix up with the install as they arrived a week earlier than agreed - but this wasn’t an issue for me.I’d recommend this supplier

This company is very professional and goes the extra yard to provide excellent service. The documentation I received as part of the quote was very enlightening. The installation was very smooth, great people, tidy, punctual, and they showed me how it worked. The customer service has been great. They are organising the grid connection after the install, I am waiting for the electricity supplier to contact me so that this can happen.

The whole process went very well from receiving the quotes to final installation.We were given several quotes all designed to help us make the best choice for us with loads of options and we were given all the information we needed to make the right decisions, we appreciated the guidance from someone who knew what our solar goals were.Installation was made to fit our schedule and was done very neatly which was good for us also.All in all a positive experience.Thank you Tasmanian Energy Company

Competitive pricing for the system, excellent communication and customer service throughout. Install went to schedule and with no issues. Moreeta and team have been fantastic deal with from from get go, taking care of pretty much every aspect of adding a solar system to our home. Would definitely recommend.
Very happy with the system supplied, from  the professional and friendly staff to the  efficient and very helpful and accomodating installers.

From Start to Finish, the initial quote was done quickly and efficiently. I was kept in the loop at all times regarding Time frames and any delays. Installation was smooth and Installer was Friendly, Punctual and provided good advice.System was checked and approved by the appropriate Authority within 2 weeks of install.

The quote I received from Niranya through Tastec was the best I’ve received in the last 2 yrs of searching for a reputable solar supplier in Tasmania.. no mucking about.. understood my needs and understanding of solar as I’ve had it before.. and did NOT “hang around” for hours doing the hard sell as most companies do! Loved the fully fem interactions as Moreeta has been fantastic with following up with the whole process.. and clarifying any questions I had.. Installation was seamless just waiting for the new power box and connection to the grid.. soo can’t wait for my first charges to come through.. then I can fully comment on the overall experience! Can’t fault it so far!

Moreeta was fantastic to deal with and made the whole process easy.Nick who installed the system did a great job and was able to offer a solution last minute with a hiccup we had on the morning of Installation that was our fault.Between him and Moreeta we were able to go ahead and have everything done that day.Installation from the time we first met with Moreeta was very fast and efficient. We couldn't be happier with the service.

I am beyond happy with both the product and the level of service I received from Niranya, Moreeta and team. The quote I was provided took into consideration the requirements of my home now and into the future, and offered me only high-end, trusted systems while factoring in my budget (which I made sure was realistic based on my own research).The team is professional and genuinely care about their customer's needs. The installation was quick and I appreciated the expertise of the installers who consulted with me when required and happily answered my questions.Moreeta consistently went above and beyond to ensure that she could deliver the best outcome, and in fact exceeded my expectations. The team are transparent and honest from the get-go. They took care of every aspect of the installation, including paperwork, liaising with power company, explaining finance options and connecting to the grid.I cannot recommend Tasmanian Energy Company enough. They are a Tasmanian business, offer the most up-to-date products and expertise but with the best kind of old-fashioned customer service - a caring local company you can trust!

Very happy with TEC. We got 2 quotes. TEC provided a much clearer quote, with very good info on the brand options, and know-how on solving the problem of our long drive, and the difficulty of our complex roof shape. Moreeta clearly had good experience in planning systems.Communication was always timely, clear and friendly.The installation was done promptly and neatly.There was a minor hitch with Solar Analytics, which TEC solved quickly.We’ll definitely use TEC when we come to install house batteries.

Niranya Livingstone provided me with quote for 4 options, the process has been conducted in friendly and professional mana.Installation went with out any dramas the installers arrived on time, communication has been in an appropriate manner.

I have had nothing but a positive experience with them.Was a slight issue, But the team have helped solve this and now everything is back on track.I would definitely send my family and friends to them for a quote and install.
Fine. I did message SolarQuotes about my quote, but got no response. Went ahead anyway, and seems to be OK.

Tasmanian Energy Company and the customer service were the worst I have ever had. They processed all the wrong details such as my name, phone number and all other personal details. Massive mistake was picked up by myself and advised them who couldn't have assured me more that the mistake was rectified. Harassed for payment before significant changes were made and now 2 month's on, still have no solar connection. Made full payment they have not got back to me but proceeds to contact the person wrongly put onto my account. No solar being able to be used at my property but yet I have had them for over 2 month's and still nothing. Emotionally and financially devastating mistake I wish we had never done. Not professional, offered no information regarding the solar panels and I have never met them they just processed everything and sent the solar installers out and the bill. Never would I recommend this company. Installation men were fabulous.

Excellent customer service. Moreeta is friendly, genuine and efficient. I have been delighted at how  painless the whole process has been. Tidy, neat and attractive installation.  A well run and coordinated process.  Thank youMoreeta.

The whole process from start to finish was carried out most efficiently and the provider and installer were most polite,tidy and punctual.  They were extremely helpful with prompt answers to all my queries.

Mareeta and the staff were great to work with.  Efficient and friendly service.  We appreciated the advice we were given to go with the flat installation of our panels that would still capture enough sun but would not impact on our view or aesthetics of our property. We were provided with a comprehensive information pack and practical advice on how to use the aurora app to monitor our use.  Thanks for this.   Already we are seeing the difference the panels are making and are very confident that we will be able to redeem our financial outlay over the next few years.  Highly recommended. :)
Friendly staff who made sure everything went smoothly. The installation was early, thanks to a cancellation, and they were able to locate some panels in a more advantageous position - bonus!
Very happy with the company I have chosen, great communication arrived when they said they would.
Easy quoting process, quick installation, great customer service, polite and friendly staff.
Excellent price and very good system but a total lack of communication from suppliers and installer no information after deposit on anything that was meant to happen had to chase it up myself

Moreeta's a great communicator so I was updated during the whole process, all my questions were answered in full and I was never left in the dark.The quote process was fast, informative and the quote itself very reasonable. Nick and Matt did a great installation, were punctual, personable, efficient and cleaned up after the job was done. The customer service was impeccable and the company organised the grid connection after the install. I have no complaints and am very happy with every aspect of the entire process.

Upgrading my original solar system which was a 3.6 kw was going to be difficult, but the owner of the company was very understanding of my needs and what i was looking for. Moreeta suggested I go with another system besides the one I already had, Moreeta gave me two options to have a look at, which I was very happy with so I chose the 4.2 kw. Unfortunately they did not have a 4.2 kw inverter so they gave me the 5 kw inverter at no extra cost with 4.4 kw of trina panels, everything went ahead better than I expected, installation was very professional, the installers were very polite and did an excellent job. I am currently producing 40 kwh on a good day and very happy with Tasmanian Energy Company.  I would highly recommend this company to anyone for solar.

The quoting was done in a very timely matter considering it was very close to Xmas. The day of the installation was great installation guys were very polite and works were completed without any issues the customer service was great I was always communicated what was going to be done am very happy to have chosen Tasmanian energy company to run this process as smoothly as it went thanks solar quotes for recommending me this company

Customer service was great, the owner of the company was more than happy to match quotes and did her best to offer what she could.Still not connected after a month of installation though..Took a while for the guys to finish and not great communication, but they got there.We’re going to upgrade to 10kw and would use them again, if they get back to us after Christmas.
From the initial meeting through to the installation, we had a great experience with the Tasmanian Energy Company. Really happy with the system we have and would definitely recommend to others!

Moreeta was great supplied me with variouse diffrent configuration quotes of panels and inverters and explained things very clearly and no pressure to purshase a system.Nick the installer was absolutely fantastic took a lot of time making sure that the panels looked and fitted the best way possiable on the roof.We tried to have a smart meter installed and nick to his credit spent ages trying to get it to work but it turned out that are wifi signal was to weak for it to work.Moreeta checked back in after install to make sure we was happy we are with the install but are waiting for Tasnetwork to change are meters over so we can turn the system on.

Here is my experience, received a reasonable price so decided to have it installed happy with the initial  correspondences and advice given. The job was scheduled to take place and due to rain wasn't completed that day. Then my experience changed  i had to chase the installers on several occasions to get a new date to finish off the install the date was cancelled again and rescheduled ,eventually over a 3 week period the job was completed. The installers seemed to have done a good job until the inspector came out to inspect the installation several weeks later and  revealed that the wrong size cable had been used and issued a defect notice, to date I'm still waiting to hear when they will be back to rectify it ?Had other issues with the accounts dept and warranty information again eventually resolvedMy experience hasn't been the best and its unlikely i would recommend them or buy from in the future
Good system price ok gave what I wanted.  Nice if power company could get act together and change power meters a lot faster
The sales person explained everything you needed to knowInstallation went like a well oiled machine, in and out in 3.5 hoursCould not complain about anything would highly recommend.Thank you

By using the SolarQuotes information, we felt much better informed and more empowered to enter the market.  The process of discussion and receiving proposals from 3 different companies resulted in us better understanding our own needs, and better understanding what options were out there.  After receiving the 3 quotes, we were then able to ask for more specific options that had become apparent during the progressive discussions.  TEC offered good pricing for a well-rated system, were happy to do a pre-site visit (even measuring the roof to verify the size of array that was possible), and actively monitored the approval and installation process so it kept ahead of schedule.
Very friendly phone calls, listened to what I wanted, fully installed within days of me accepting quote.
I was happy with sales department.  The installation team. No fuss just came in set up. Before i knew it. The new system is on the roof ready to go.

A big thank you to the team at Tasmanian Energy Company for great service, professional approach, and a quality system that is performing so very well.  The quote was very good and the installer was professional, thorough and tidy. I couldn't be happier.
the process from start to finish was stressless. I was kept well informed and the installation was performed very professionally under trying conditions.A job well done.

After a small hiccup initially, the quoting procedure was excellent and quick with a range of systems quoted and calculated payback periods presented in nice reports. We chose one of the cheaper systems to obtain a 6 year payback period. Overall, we are very happy with the product and install. The installation happened very quickly after agreeing on a quote. The panels look great installed and are neatly lined up with a high quality aluminium cover over the DC isolator. Ours is a two story house and the routing for cabling was not straight forward, but the installers came up with a nice solution which keeps the exposed conduit to a minimum and the cable run as short as possible. I had to replace a couple of screws into plaster with dedicated plaster anchors as these were loose immediately, but otherwise all was very neat and professional. We had a Solar Analytics system installed at the same time and the installers helped set that up and they filled out all paperwork for grid connection.  We had a smart meter, so were producing solar on the day of the install!  Many thanks for a great product and overall experience.

Once we negotiated the equipment I did the research on everything went like clockwork. The sales side of things we went well and they kept me in the loop at all stages, even with upgrading to slightly larger panels as the suppliers had run out of the others. All this at no extra cost. The installers were great and really good to deal with. Very neat job and really tidy. As I already had a Smart Meter the connection was a breeze and I was in generating power within days.
From day one, quote to final installation, very good.

As a man in my late 80's I wanted to have a system that was quality, lasting as a legacy item on my home, offering value for money with no hassles or issues from start to finish. The sales representative from TEC was fantastic and sold me an additional 14 panels to my current 5kW system. The information was well presented, the call backs and communication was excellent and the dealings with council and survey was a simple process. I would highly recommend this company to anyone considering installing solar system from a true Tasmanian business. Thank you Jim
Quoting was ok. Installation was tidy and polite. Yes they organise connection and installation.

Moreeta was great. Very professional and in constant communication with me. Explained various different configuration quotes of panels and inverters, with no pressure to purchase system. A very friendly and caring approach. Phone calls always returned when I called various times with questions. Moreeta was able to answer them all and would approach installers to clarify further information. When it came to installation, this happened a lot more quickly than anticipated.Nick the installer was fantastic and quick under half a day to install, with system left up and running .The 6.6 kw system has being working well, although I am still waiting for Aurora to install new smart meter.Moreeta checked back in after install to make sure I was happy with installation.I highly recommend Tasmania  Energy Company to others for honest, reliable and great affordable pricing.

System was installed earlier this week, and not yet linked to the grid, so a little early to tell how reliable and effective it is.  Installation took longer than expected partly due to mix up in our address, but the guys arrived as scheduled, were polite and did a good job.

The sales/quoting process was excellent. I few options were considered before settling on the final installation, with rapid amendments made to the quote, and emailed to me quickly. Because of the particular nature of the job, (the roof it was being installed on), The job was expected to take longer than normal, and an additional cost to the labour was added for the extra time taken. The installers were polite & punctual, arrived on time, and took all day to do the job. A slight change to the configuration of the panels was necessary. The installers gave me a figure of extra cost to do this. I agreed and they went ahead with it. (I was actually invoiced $50 less than expected). It looks a good neat job, to me. I was expecting connection by last Wed., but contacted TasNetworks to ask what was happening. I was told they hadn't received the EWR. I am still waiting for this to be resolved. (A few years ago, I had solar installed on another residence, and had similar "duck shoving" between TasNetworks)
Easy to understand, genuine salesman. One stop shop who supplied us with air con and hws as well as Solar

I have had over the last twenty years purchased three solar systems, installed on three different private homes.The Tasmanian energy Company experience exceeds the other two purchases by a very large margin.I was very impressed with Moreeta's practical advice and understanding of my requirements, I accepted her easy to understand quote within half a day because I had complete confidence in what she had told me.The installation was incredibly quick, under half a day and most importantly unlike previous installations the installer left no debris on the roof and removed all the various packagingThe 6.0kw system has worked from the day of installation although I am still waiting for Auroa to install a new meter. On a good day the system is generating 25KW + which is above my initial expectations and currently spinning my meter backwards!All in all an enjoyable process managed by an experienced professional. I have no hesitation in recommending Tasmanian Energy Company as a solar company with integrity.

Firstly Matt the on road quoter was great, he really knew his stuff and had uploaded an aerial view with panels on the picture, he had a very detailed quote ready for us to view when he arrived. He was also helpful in the negotiating process as we were down to two suppliers. Installation took all day but the guys were careful on our tiled roof and did not break one tile, they were polite and there was no mess left behind. They did have an issue with the Sunny Boy registration process but they said it was normal. The paperwork was lodged the following day with power supplier.We are still waiting on Aurora to contact us regarding connection a week later but this is not the installers fault. I would thoroughly recommend Tasmanian Energy Company for your solar
They contacted us after I went on your site for a quote.They were very helpful and everything went smoothly
Sales person was friendly and knowledgeable. So as the installers. They worked fast in a team. It was professional. Only downsize was administration office had little communication with ground staff.
